name: OS Computer Use
description: macOS 桌面计算机使用，支持窗口列表、截图、辅助功能树和受审批约束的单步输入。

features.name: 主屏和指定窗口截图，直接提供给视觉模型
features.nameEn: Primary display and window screenshots for vision models

features.name: 指定窗口点击、滚动、快捷键与 Unicode 输入
features.nameEn: Targeted clicks, scrolling, keyboard shortcuts and Unicode input

features.name: 可见窗口列表、目标聚焦与坐标换算
features.nameEn: Visible windows, verified focus and coordinate mapping

features.name: 逐次审批与 macOS 系统权限检查
features.nameEn: Per-action approval and macOS permission checks

features.name: macOS 14 及以上桌面原生适配器
features.nameEn: Native desktop adapter for macOS 14 or later

features.name: 交互证据包含动作、目标、时间和序号
features.nameEn: Interaction evidence with action, target, timestamp and sequence

features.name: 指定窗口的辅助功能树与控件坐标
features.nameEn: Window accessibility tree and control coordinates
